field_verifications.evidence_text: we further analyzed peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) for changes in frequency and activation status of innate immune cell subsets, including myeloid and plasmacytoid dendritic cells (mDCs and pDCs, respectively), monocytes, and NK cells.
